reason: A named independent lab and a batch report that matches the box is exactly what I check before I buy anything, and the sachets are easy to throw in a bag when I travel. At $24.99 for the first box I will try one, not two.
objection: I will look up the lab myself and open the report for my batch. If the lab is unknown or the report is generic, it is marketing and I am out. Also $29.99 a month is more than the magnesium I can get in a bottle.
